CustomField.description: Closest Future Sales Activity, determined across leads and contacts matched to the account, based on roll-ups from DLRS.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Closest_Future_Event_Account__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Closest_Future_Task_Account__c))), IF( Closest_Future_Event_Account__c > Closest_Future_Task_Account__c, Closest_Future_Event_Account__c, Closest_Future_Task_Account__c ), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Closest_Future_Event_Account__c)), Closest_Future_Event_Account__c, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Closest_Future_Task_Account__c)), Closest_Future_Task_Account__c, NULL ) ) )
CustomField.label: Future Sales Activity
